title: Appointment cancelled notice
description: Inform a patient that an appointment was cancelled and offer to rebook. Account alert WhatsApp template for healthcare. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Apologize briefly and offer a one-tap path to rebook. Avoid reasons that reveal health information.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your appointment with {{doctor}} on {{date}} at {{time}} was cancelled. We're sorry for the inconvenience, and we'd like to find you a new time.
